historical_record.description: The property was the Katherine Delmar Burke School, a private elementary school, which sought to expand.

The City Planning Commission granted conditional-use authorization for a planned unit development, 5-0 and with conditions, to expand and modify the Katherine Delmar Burke School, to plans by ROMA Design Group dated 24 March 1994 (Motion 13678).
